scope.basis: Read-only behavioral and lifecycle review of current local program bytes and already-emitted local launch artifacts.

evidence: fp8_actual.py:110-121 constructs Fp8OnlineLinearMethod, calls create_weights and process_weights_after_loading, requires emitted float8_e4m3fn, and records the concrete fp8_linear identity.
fp8_actual.py:155-163 times fp8_method.apply and feeds that timed output to the matched BF16 oracle.

Exact-image source probe confirmed Fp8OnlineLinearMethod.process_weights_after_loading uses ops.scaled_fp8_quant and Fp8LinearMethod.apply dispatches its selected fp8_linear when batch-invariant mode is not enabled; the container command does not inject that mode.
fp8_actual.py:27-37 lists all six exact K/N/multiplicity tuples, decode M=12/14, prefill M=3679/8730, and 358 output tokens.
fp8_actual.py:350-369 executes every linear cross-product, both head rows, primary/10K KV prefill, and c12/c14 local plus start/peak global KV decode rows.
fp8_actual.py:296-326 weights 50/10/60 layer multiplicities, leaves prefill undivided, and divides 358-step decode work by concurrency exactly once.
fp8_actual.py:124-131 uses UnquantizedLinearMethod; lines 159-179 compare the timed FP8 output with the timed BF16 output.
fp8_actual.py:191-223 uses actual ParallelLMHead at M=12/M=14 and validates the timed logits against an analytical constant-weight reference.
fp8_actual.py:134-147 requires finite, nonzero outputs and both absolute and relative tolerances; lines 247-260 consume the timed KV cache side effect.
bf16_comparators_head_and_oracles.limitation: The FP8 tensors are constant nonzero tensors and the nontrivial test is only absmax>1e-4; this is a weak oracle for layout-sensitive faults, though not by itself the quarantine reason.

evidence: fp8_actual.py:226-287 calls the pinned vLLM custom op reshape_and_cache_flash with FP8 caches, explicit unit K/V scales, exact local/global heads and dimensions, and validates written slots.
Exact-image source inspection shows Fp8KVCacheMethod is an empty BaseKVCacheMethod specialization; the actual writer is the invoked torch.ops._C_cache_ops.reshape_and_cache_flash wrapper.
fp8_actual.py:309-319 adds KV writes only and explicitly lists attention reads/compute as omitted at lines 343-344, avoiding the prior analytical KV-read double count.

timing_stability_acceptance.defect: All scientific rows can pass with arbitrarily unstable, zero, or nonfinite timing distributions because row pass is only the numerical oracle. No stability or positive-finite timing predicate is evaluated before aggregation or the W4 trigger.
evidence: fp8_actual.py:56-84 records raw/p50/p95/min/max CUDA and wall values but computes no stability predicate.
fp8_actual.py:184 sets a linear row pass solely to oracle.pass; line 219 does the same for the head and line 283 for KV.
fp8_actual.py:370-385 defines valid only as row-count plus row.pass and immediately drives economic surfaces and W4 admission from it.
w4_actual.py:109 and 156 similarly accept rows solely from numerical oracles; no timing stability gate exists.

telemetry_acceptance.defect: Telemetry is attempted but never checked for existence, nonempty samples, parseability, exact L40S identity, HBM capacity, power, or utilization before a stage passes.
evidence: remote_stage.sh:41-44 launches nvidia-smi sampling in a background subshell.
remote_stage.sh:13-30 suppresses telemetry termination/wait errors during teardown and merely archives files.
remote_stage.sh:50-67 forms the typed terminal only from benchmark returncode/result booleans; neither telemetry.csv nor nvidia-smi identity is consumed.
mla_microbench_control.py:261-265 verifies archive structure/hash but does not evaluate telemetry contents.

typed_economic_semantics.defect: The typed field economic_both_envelopes_falsified is assigned the negation of the W4 trigger, not the measured relationship to both ceilings. A strong FP8 pass therefore falsely declares both envelopes falsified; a missed deadline can do the same.
evidence: fp8_actual.py:380-385 defines positive residual, strong_pass, and w4_trigger.
fp8_actual.py:397 writes economic_both_envelopes_falsified = not w4_trigger, although strong_pass means a positive residual of at least 0.35 seconds/request.
remote_stage.sh:57-63 promotes this value into the typed stage terminal.
w4_actual.py:32-59 constructs AWQMarlinLinearMethod, fills group-128 asymmetric packed weights, dequantizes the oracle, calls process_weights_after_loading, and rejects a non-Marlin selected kernel.
w4_actual.py:81-110 times actual W4, matched online FP8, and BF16 consumers and consumes all timed outputs in numerical oracles.
w4_actual.py:151-180 executes all six shapes at M=14/M=16 and applies the preregistered reduction/component gates.

strict_same_session_w4_trigger.defect: The trigger does not enforce nonzero GPU science or the exact residual condition, and the typed same-session assertion is a literal true rather than an observed owner/watchdog binding.
evidence: fp8_actual.py:383-385 permits W4 whenever valid and not strong_pass. If allocator fit fails while planning residual is >=0.35, strong_pass is false and W4 fires even though the required residual condition is false.
fp8_actual.py:385 and 394 equate valid with valid_nonzero_fp8 without requiring useful_gpu_seconds>0 or positive finite event rows.
fp8_actual.py:394 writes same_owner_session=True without consuming an owner/watchdog identity.

l40s_fp8_owner.py:40-44 rechecks pass/rows/deadline/file hashes but still does not check useful GPU time, the numerical residual itself, or watchdog identity. The controller is sequential on one retained instance, which mitigates but does not satisfy the typed trigger contract.

immutable_transitive_program_binding.defect: The launch does not bind the complete transitive lifecycle program and does not prove the remotely executed bytes equal the audited bytes. This is an explicit pre-create contract failure.
evidence: audit_final_program.py:13 hashes fp8_actual.py, w4_actual.py, remote_stage.sh, assert_identity.py, l40s_fp8_owner.py, and mla_microbench_control.py, but omits placement_control.py, awq_smoke_control.py, stock_control.py, and vllm_smoke_control.py imported by the controller at mla_microbench_control.py:21-43.

l40s_fp8_owner.py:23 drops l40s_fp8_owner.py from FILES; its pre-create staged_bytes_match_audit at lines 61-70 therefore does not bind the actual provider-mutating owner even though the audit artifact contains that hash.
mla_microbench_control.py:244-250 SCPs the then-current mutable files after bootstrap. No immutable snapshot/copy is created at pre-create and no expected digest is passed to the remote stage.

remote_stage.sh:35-40 records only the benchmark file hash at runtime. It does not hash remote_stage.sh or the imported fp8_actual.py transitive dependency used by w4_actual.py, and the controller never compares runtime.json against FINAL_STAGED_PROGRAM_AUDIT.json.
Current omitted dependency hashes are recorded in audited_identity, but they are observations after create, not a launch-time immutable capture.
l40s_fp8_owner.py:61-83 requires a real user-systemd owner, empty inventory, the exact placement/cap, and delegates one sequential allocation to the shared controller.

mla_microbench_control.py:198-223 wraps create in VerifiedRetainedOwner, binds the instance, and starts an independent watchdog; local events.jsonl records instance computeinstance-e00pq6c1wsmgx6c791 and watchdog unit/PID.
mla_microbench_control.py:249-265 retrieves each stage atomically, checks remote/local archive SHA-256 and internal manifest, reads one typed terminal, then writes the stage record.

mla_microbench_control.py:286-307 always evaluates authenticated cleanup evidence and derives exposure cost at the admitted VM+disk rates. placement_control.py:332-338 forces cleanup and rejects missing typed completion.
durable_owner_retrieval_accounting_clean.limitation: At audit time only create/SSH events existed; no terminal stage or cleanup artifact was yet present. This advisory did not poll or mutate the live owner.

quarantine_reasons: No timing stability or positive-finite timing acceptance gate, so economic rows and the retained W4 decision are not scientifically typed.
Required HBM/power/utilization telemetry can be empty or invalid without failing science.
W4 trigger does not strictly enforce nonzero science, the exact residual predicate, or observed same-owner/watchdog identity.
Provider-mutating owner, controller dependencies, and remote execution bytes lack a complete immutable launch-time binding.
interpretation_rule: Do not accept any eventual FP8/W4 pass, economic classification, or nomination from this program as campaign evidence. Raw retrieved rows may be inspected diagnostically after authenticated cleanup, but require a fresh corrected run for a scientific claim; this audit does not authorize a repair or another allocation.
